_: Identity contract for names SHARED across node modules (the borrowing seam). One canonical arity + argument sorts + document-wide gloss per name. corpus_gate.py enforces arity conformance (hard tier); glosses for these names must never be section-local. Ruled 2026-08-16, grounds in SEAM_CONTRACT.md.

root_authority.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions

system_authority.gloss: R carries the system level of instruction authority

developer_authority.gloss: R carries the developer level of instruction authority

user_authority.gloss: R carries the user level of instruction authority

guideline_authority.gloss: R carries the guideline level of instruction authority: guidance rather than strict requirement

authority_levels_hierarchy.gloss: authority level H (first argument) outranks authority level L (second argument) in the ordering root > system > developer > user > guideline

assistant_definition.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it

model_spec.gloss: D is the Model Spec document

message_role_definition.gloss: message M (first argument) has role R (second argument), one of system, developer, user, assistant, tool; the role specifies the message's source and determines its authority

developer_instruction.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the developer authority level

user_instruction.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the user authority level

higher_level_instruction.gloss: I is an instruction from an authority level that outranks the level of the instruction under evaluation

answers_question.gloss: response R (first argument) answers question Q (second argument)

delegated_power.gloss: power P over a matter (first argument) is delegated by the Model Spec to authority level L (second argument)

information_hazards_prohibition.gloss: R is the rule prohibiting detailed actionable steps for information hazards (e.g. biological amplification, weapons)
